scope: Original paper, publisher model/pipeline and author repository metadata; no waveform/array comparison. Frozen first-pair and full v2 plans untouched.
source_model_family: Visual3D; the original .mdh model is not an OpenSim .osim file.

primary_sources.finding: Published figures and author exploration use right-leg curves; this is not an explicit left processed-column sign definition.
Seven publisher files include original model, overground pipeline and exploratory MATLAB script; no separately identified treadmill pipeline or final ang/knt means producer.
Untruncated original lab repository tree has no WBDS processing directory/files. README points back to publisher DOI; no additional final exporter discovered.
Author dataset page identifies Visual3D model/pipeline. Search result accessible; direct fetch timed out. No extra sign definition obtained.

confirmed_chain.source_column_anatomical_labels: wbdsExploratoryDA.m lines 80-93 uses orderXYZ=[3 1 2] and explicit anatomical signs; actual selection at113 and197 constructs R-prefixed names. It does not independently label L-prefixed columns.
confirmed_chain.model: WBDSmodel.mdh paired thigh/shank blocks use homologous side-specific landmarks. AP_DIRECTION/AXIAL_DIRECTION are commented for these segments. Virtual-foot axes are explicit but insufficient alone to establish the complete joint frames.
confirmed_chain.pipeline: Six pairs of angle/moment blocks have matching active/default sagittal Z negation settings. This supports bilateral correspondence but cannot establish final processed-column sign without model/export linkage.
confirmed_chain.export: Export_Data_To_Ascii_File blocks export LHip/LKnee/LAnkle and left moments using LON+LON; final participant-condition ang/knt tables are not generated by the supplied script. The provided pipeline opens walkO recordings.

missing_evidence.needed: Exact final export/concatenation operation from Visual3D left joint outputs into LHipAngleZ/LKneeAngleZ/LAnkleAngleZ and left moment columns.
missing_evidence.why: Proves column order/signs were retained rather than inferred from column naming.

missing_evidence.needed: Treadmill producer or explicit publisher declaration that the same bilateral coordinate/sign definitions apply to those processed fields.
missing_evidence.why: Overground pipeline alone cannot establish the treadmill branch.

missing_evidence.needed: Complete effective paired segment coordinate definitions for the original Visual3D version, or an explicit author left-column anatomical sign table.
missing_evidence.why: Matching negate flags do not determine underlying resolving-axis directions; commented defaults are not explicit source assignments.

decision: No additional left canonical mapping is justified by the newly found primary evidence. Preserve all left source components for every pair; retain tentative mappings only as hypotheses, not executable transformations. This does not block full coverage of published means.
prohibited_shortcuts: No sign inference from matching left/right waveforms.
No substitution of generic OpenSim conventions for the original Visual3D model.
No silent copy of right-side anatomical labels to left-side fields.
next_safe_action: Allow the already queued first-pair source-preservation pilot to proceed under existing guards; root reviews actual outputs before full resume. Resolve source-coordinate provenance independently of that scheduling.
